title: skill-adoption cross-run registry entry
description: One line of results/registry.jsonl per cell ever run, written by the orchestrator BEFORE the subject is launched (so a crashed or abandoned cell still leaves a trace -- unlike runs.jsonl, which only gets a line on a cell that finished). Generalizes ai-text-editor-usage/LAB-PROTOCOL.md's subjects-registry.jsonl across scenarios, CLIs and modes. This is the durable index: to find cell run_id's subject session later, look it up here.

subject_label.description: e.g. S04-decisions-claude-mcp-2 -- the interactive-shell --session id used, for direct resumption of the PTY wrapper session's own logs

workspace.description: the mktemp -d path used. Recorded for audit even though it is deleted on teardown -- a run_id's workspace path is part of its provenance even after the directory itself is gone.

outcome.description: completed means a matching runs.jsonl line exists. Anything else means it does not, and this registry line is the only trace that the cell was attempted at all -- never silently drop a non-completed attempt from the registry, that is exactly the information a reproducer needs to know their rep count target wasn't actually met.
